items.claim: The boundaries 7:28/8:1 and 8:4/8:5 hold as form, and medium_low is the honest grade for a behold step inside one vision. The defect is in the rejected-alternative field: it says the 8:4/8:5 edge is the only internal cut of the twelve-verse report with a device on its onset side. The device inventory holds devices on the onset side of three other candidate edges: 8:3 carries the lifted-eyes formula, the behold formula and the seeing verb; 8:4 opens on the seeing verb; 8:6 carries the seeing verb. The row's own rationale names the 8:3 devices as interior. So the stated ground is contradicted by the layer, it carries no tier, and the rival it hides (setting 8:1-8:2 against the ram from 8:3) is never weighed.
items.both_sides: No cut is proposed. For the unweighed rival edge 8:2/8:3: close side, 8:2 ends the setting (Susa, the river) and repeats the seeing-in-the-vision clause; onset side, 8:3 has the lifted-eyes formula, which the inventory finds in two verses of the book (8:3 and 10:5), with the behold formula and the first animal. For the edge taken, 8:4/8:5: close side, 8:4 ends on the ram doing his will and growing great; onset side, 8:5 has the seer's own clause and the behold formula. Both edges have devices on the onset side; the row keeps the setting with the ram, which is defensible, but it must say so on true grounds.

suggested_fix.fact: Devices stand on the onset side of 8:3 (lifted-eyes formula, behold formula, seeing verb), 8:4 (seeing verb, first word) and 8:6 (seeing verb) as well as 8:5; the 8:4/8:5 edge is preferred because it is where the vision passes from the first animal to the second, not because it alone has a device. The 8:2/8:3 rival (setting against vision) is to be named and weighed, with its tier.

evidence: GRAVEST (rejected-alternative field): the sentence that 8:4/8:5 is the only cut with a device on its onset side. Device inventory, MT face, identity numbering in chapter 8: Dan.8.3 = i_saw_heb, lifted_eyes_and_saw_heb, behold_heb; Dan.8.4 = i_saw_heb; Dan.8.5 = behold_heb; Dan.8.6 = i_saw_heb; lifted_eyes_and_saw_heb verses_mt = Dan.8.3, Dan.10.5 (my read-only script over the pinned inventory).

Found by my own five-word window over the clean WEB text; the suite reads hard GREEN, so its window may be scoped differently.

THIRD (tier words, low): device_notes holds three untiered facts, all true on test: no ketiv/qere note in 8:1-8:4 (the mark layer's only chapter-8 ketiv/qere verse is 8:11), a paseq at 8:3 (mark layer: paseq at 8:3, 8:5, 8:7 in this chapter), and the parent wholly Hebrew (language-zone layer: every verse 8:1-8:27 is H).

TESTED AND TRUE: all 15 Hebrew runs are substrings of the witness at their cited verse; both WEB quotations are verbatim; the 8:1 dateline wording equals the inventory's web_text; the language returns to Hebrew at Dan.8.1 word 1 (language-zone layer runs and the inventory's language_switches); PE after 7:28 (mark layer, single witness); no mark after any verse 8:1-8:26.

FLAGS answered (9): the six register flags are layer attributions inside evidence references and schema grade words, none a form defect; of the three universals, 'never decides' and 'count-only' are labels, and 'no seeing or behold marker' at 8:9 is true of the inventory (no formula at Dan.8.9).

items.claim: 8:5-8:12 is one movement of the vision report (the goat, the breaking of its horn, the horn that grows from one of the four), opened by the seer's own clause with the behold formula at 8:5 and closed at 8:12 on a doing-and-prospering clause before the mode changes to hearing at 8:13. The 8:8/8:9 rival has no device on either side and 8:9 depends on 8:8 for its antecedent. medium_low is honest: the onset is a scene step inside one vision.
items.both_sides: Onset 8:4/8:5: 8:4 closes the ram on his will and greatness; 8:5 has the seer's clause and the behold formula. Close 8:12/8:13: 8:12 ends on the horn acting and prospering, parallel in form to the end of 8:4; 8:13 opens on a hearing verb, a new mode and new speakers. Rival 8:8/8:9: 8:8 ends on the four horns; 8:9 begins from one of them with no seeing or behold device.
evidence: Device inventory: Dan.8.5 = behold_heb; Dan.8.6 = i_saw_heb; no formula at Dan.8.7 to Dan.8.12; Dan.8.13 = vision_noun_hazon_heb, and_he_said_heb (my read-only script).

TESTED AND TRUE: all 11 Hebrew runs are substrings at their cited verse; the WEB quotation of 8:12 is verbatim; ketiv/qere at 8:11 is the only one in the chapter and is disclosed; paseq at 8:5 and 8:7 match the mark layer; no PE or SAMEKH stands inside or at either edge of the row.

NOTE (low, not raised to a challenge): observed_substrate_signals lists and_he_said_heb with no verse; the inventory has it at 8:13, outside the row, so it is a far-side signal and is not labelled as one (the row labels other far-side signals by verse elsewhere in this part).

NOTE (low): the inventory's seeing-verb pattern does not match the suffixed form that opens 8:7, web:Dan.8.7 “I saw him come close to the ram”; the seeing verb the row cites at 8:6 stands in a relative clause that points back to the ram. Neither changes an edge.

TIER (answered under the first triage item): the rejected-alternative field's absence claim at 8:9 is true of the inventory and untiered.

FLAGS answered (13): seven register flags are layer attributions or a grade word; the universals are labels (count-only, reading form only) except 'has no step device' at 8:9, tested true against the inventory.

items.claim: 8:13-8:14 is a bounded audition: 8:13 moves from seeing to hearing with a question between holy ones, and 8:14 gives the answer and ends it. 8:15 then opens with the narrative verb, the seer's name and the behold formula. Both edges have text signals on both sides, no mark stands at either, and medium agrees with the strategy's expected grade for 8:14/8:15. heavenly_discourse fits the vocabulary (speech by heavenly figures, the answer addressed to the seer).
items.both_sides: Onset 8:12/8:13: 8:12 closes the horn's success; 8:13 opens on the hearing verb and a how-long question. Close 8:14/8:15: 8:14 ends the answer on the sanctuary; 8:15 has vayehi_heb, i_daniel_heb and behold_heb and turns to the seer's search for understanding. The later speech calls this exchange part of what was shown (8:26 looks back to its evening-and-morning count); that is why the forward merge is a real rival; the row weighs and declines it.
evidence: Device inventory: Dan.8.13 = vision_noun_hazon_heb, and_he_said_heb; Dan.8.14 = and_he_said_heb, and_he_said_to_me_heb; Dan.8.15 = i_daniel_heb, vision_noun_hazon_heb, vision_noun_mareh_heb, behold_heb, vayehi_heb (my read-only script).
Mark layer (WLC/OSHB, single witness): no PE or SAMEKH after Dan.8.12, Dan.8.13 or Dan.8.14; the only mark in the chapter is PE after Dan.8.27. No ketiv/qere note at 8:13 or 8:14.
TESTED AND TRUE: all 13 Hebrew runs are substrings at their cited verse; both WEB quotations are verbatim.
NOTE (low): observed_substrate_signals lists vayehi_heb and i_daniel_heb with no verse; the inventory has both at 8:15, outside the row (far-side signals, unlabelled).
NOTE (low, register): the rationale points to a lettered region of the planning record for its grade instead of stating the ground by content.

NOTE (tier): the divided-reading sentence is tiered REPORTED and names no source for the 1,150-day count or the day-for-a-year basis; the strategy holds only that 8:14 is the basis of the Seventh-day Adventist sanctuary doctrine. REPORTED is not stronger than the evidence, so no defect is raised; the source gap is named.
FLAGS answered (2): both are the mark layer's file name inside an evidence reference, an attribution.

items.claim: The span 8:15-8:18 is rightly bounded, but its unit_type is not the type the verses have. The four verses narrate, in the first person, the seer's search, a figure appearing, a voice commissioning Gabriel, the approach, the seer's fear and fall, a deep sleep and being set upright; the only interpretive words are the second half of 8:17. The closed vocabulary defines narrative to include first-person framing in the visions and defines interpretation as the reading of a vision. The row's own device note says the span is largely narrative and discloses the type as a deviation. The reading itself begins at 8:19, which the next row holds.
items.both_sides: No cut is proposed. Onset 8:14/8:15: 8:14 ends the audition; 8:15 has vayehi_heb, i_daniel_heb and behold_heb. Close 8:18/8:19: 8:18 ends the collapse with the seer set upright; 8:19 has only the weak speech verb and the announcement, and it resumes the speech begun in 8:17 (both verses end on the end-time phrase), so medium_low is honest. The turn from report to interpretation that the strategy places at 8:15 is the turn of the chapter, not the type of these four verses.

suggested_fix.fact: 8:15-8:18 is first-person narrative framing (appearance, commission, collapse, restoration) that introduces the interpretation; the type that the closed vocabulary gives such framing is narrative, and the single interpretive clause at the end of 8:17 can be disclosed in the device note.

evidence: GRAVEST (unit_type): web:Dan.8.15 “I sought to understand it”; web:Dan.8.17 “So he came near where I stood”; web:Dan.8.18 “I fell into a deep sleep”; against the one interpretive clause web:Dan.8.17 “for the vision belongs to the time of the end”. The row's device note states the span is largely narrative of the seer's experience.

SECOND (tier and pointer, low): device_notes says the 8:17 address differs in wording from the Aramaic figure of 7:13 and adds a parenthesis saying that figure is spliced above, tiered EXTRACTED. No field of this row quotes 7:13. The fact itself holds in the named layers: the witness at Dan.7.13 has the Aramaic phrase and the inventory has son_of_man_aram at Dan.7.13 and son_of_man_heb at Dan.8.17; the language-zone layer has 7:13 as A and 8:17 as H. The defect is the pointer to a quotation the row does not carry.
THIRD (register, low): the rationale gives its grade by pointing to a lettered region of the planning record.
TIER WORDS TESTED (all 18 in three fields): every EXTRACTED and MEASURED word names a layer that holds its fact; detail under the second triage item.

TESTED AND TRUE: all 16 Hebrew runs are substrings at their cited verse; the three WEB quotations are verbatim; inventory Dan.8.15, Dan.8.16, Dan.8.17 and Dan.8.19 hold every device the row names; Dan.8.18 holds none.

FLAGS answered (5): three grade or schema words; 'first interpretive statement' at 8:17 is a reading and is tiered INFERRED; 'the only onset signal' at 8:19 agrees with the inventory, which has and_he_said_heb alone there.

items.claim: 8:19-8:26 is one speech act: Gabriel's announcement at 8:19, the decoding of ram, goat and horns, the later king, and the confirmation and sealing command at 8:26; 8:27 returns to the seer's own voice. No speaker change or inventory device stands at the 8:22/8:23 rival. Eight verses is inside the range. medium_low is honest because the onset at 8:19 rests on a weak speech verb and resumes a speech that began in 8:17.
items.both_sides: Onset 8:18/8:19: 8:18 ends the restoration of the seer; 8:19 has the speech verb and the announcement, and repeats the end-time ground of 8:17. Close 8:26/8:27: 8:26 looks back to the evenings and mornings and commands the sealing; 8:27 opens on the seer's name in the first person (i_daniel_heb, and_i_daniel_heb). Rival 8:22/8:23: 8:22 ends on four kingdoms; 8:23 opens on a temporal phrase the row quotes, with no change of speaker.
evidence: Device inventory: Dan.8.19 = and_he_said_heb; no formula at Dan.8.20 to Dan.8.25; Dan.8.26 = vision_noun_hazon_heb, vision_noun_mareh_heb; Dan.8.27 = i_daniel_heb, and_i_daniel_heb, vision_noun_mareh_heb (my read-only script).

web:Dan.8.19 “for it belongs to the appointed time of the end” beside web:Dan.8.17 “for the vision belongs to the time of the end”: the speech of 8:19 takes up the ground given in 8:17. The row does not name this link; it supports the row's own medium_low at the onset and is offered as a fact to add, not a defect.
TESTED AND TRUE: all 10 Hebrew runs are substrings at their cited verse; the four WEB quotations are verbatim; no ketiv/qere note in 8:19-8:26; no PE or SAMEKH inside the row or at either edge.
TIER (answered under the first triage item): the rejected-alternative field and the device note hold true claims without tier words.
FLAGS answered (1): a grade word in prose.

items.claim: 8:27 is the closing notice of the vision: it leaves Gabriel's speech for the seer's own report (illness, return to the king's business, wonder, no understanding), it stands where the strategy lists the chapter's closure, and a dateline opens 9:1 after it. A one-verse row is allowed for a closing notice. Medium is right: the close is strong on both sides and the onset is the weaker edge, since the verse can also be read as the tail of the speech row.
items.both_sides: Onset 8:26/8:27: 8:26 ends the speech on the sealing command; 8:27 opens on the seer's name with the conjunction (and_i_daniel_heb, found in this one verse of the book). Close 8:27/9:1: 8:27 ends on incomprehension, with PE after it (WLC/OSHB, single witness); 9:1 is a regnal dateline of a new king.
evidence: Device inventory: Dan.8.27 = i_daniel_heb, and_i_daniel_heb, vision_noun_mareh_heb; and_i_daniel_heb count 1; datelines verses_mt include Dan.9.1 (my read-only script).

triage_answers.decision: W4-011: all 18 tier words tested (boundary_rationale 6 EXTRACTED, 5 INFERRED, 1 MEASURED; strongest_rejected_alternative 3 INFERRED; device_notes 1 INFERRED, 1 EXTRACTED, 1 MEASURED). No tier is stronger than its evidence and every named layer holds its fact. One defect beside a tier word: the device note's EXTRACTED sentence about 7:13 points to a quotation 'spliced above' that the row does not contain.
evidence: EXTRACTED, 8:15 opening words, behold formula and appearance noun: the Hebrew run is a substring of the witness at Dan.8.15; inventory Dan.8.15 has behold_heb and vision_noun_mareh_heb. True.
EXTRACTED (WEB), the seer seeks understanding: web:Dan.8.15 “I sought to understand it”. In the layer, in paraphrase. True.

MEASURED (mark layer), no mark at the 8:14/8:15 seam: the mark layer has no entry for Dan.8.14; the chapter's only mark is PE after Dan.8.27. True; the row names the layer and not the measurement, and my script re-measured it.
EXTRACTED, 8:16: the Hebrew run is a substring at Dan.8.16 and the WEB quotation is verbatim. True.
EXTRACTED, 8:17 address and end-time phrase with son_of_man_heb and time_of_the_end_heb: both Hebrew runs are substrings at Dan.8.17 and the inventory has both formulae there. True.
EXTRACTED, 8:18 close and 8:19 opening: Hebrew runs are substrings at their verses; both WEB quotations verbatim. True.

INFERRED (eight in the rationale and the rejected alternative): each stands beside a weighing or a grade (8:14 closes the audition; the grade at the seam; the first interpretive statement; the announcement as the only onset signal; the close grade; Gabriel as the one who comes near; 8:17-8:18 as a frame; 8:18/8:19 grade). All are readings; INFERRED is their true tier.
MEASURED (mark layer), no ketiv/qere note in 8:15-8:18: the layer's only chapter-8 ketiv/qere verse is Dan.8.11. True.

EXTRACTED (OSHB/WLC and language-zone layer), 8:17's address differs in wording from the Aramaic figure of 7:13: the witness at Dan.7.13 and Dan.8.17 and the zone layer (A and H) hold the difference, so the tier is true of the fact; the parenthesis 'spliced above' is false of the row.
INFERRED, the unit_type sentence in the device note: a reading about the row's own type; true tier (the type itself is challenged in the W4-011 item).

triage_answers.decision: W4-011 carries author notes (a), (b) and the mixed-sentence case (c). I tested (a) and (b) against the pinned bytes and reach the ruling's findings independently: both tiers are true and no change is needed. Notes (d), (e) and (f) concern rows outside this cluster and are not tested here.
evidence: (a) web:Dan.8.15 “I sought to understand it” holds the claim in paraphrase with the tense changed; EXTRACTED (WEB) is true.
(b) web:Dan.8.17 “So he came near where I stood” has a pronoun; the name stands in 8:16, in the voice's address; that the one who comes near is Gabriel is a reading, and INFERRED is its true tier.

The genre-word question of note (e) does not arise in this cluster: no W4-008 to W4-013 field sets MEASURED beside a language word and a genre word.
